acceptance_status: Proposed nominal simulation gate; not physical or general reliability certification

development.purpose: Repeated diagnostic comparison; never report as fresh qualification

held_out.purpose: Reserved qualification set; exclude from demonstrations, fitting and development tuning
held_out.run_after: Freeze a candidate that passes the nominal development gate
held_out.failed_qualification: Retain the failure report; any subsequent reuse is regression evidence, not a fresh holdout

robustness: After nominal qualification, freeze explicit camera-estimation noise and delay scenarios; simulation does not validate the real two-camera pipeline
